data.content_ref: inline:The flags are sustained because the neighborhood reveals a self-consistency property of the falsificationist stance: SRC_006 and SRC_008 independently confirm each other's verdicts on SRC_005 (both declared sound and relevant), which in turn licenses the propagation of failure verdicts SRC_007 and SRC_009. The adjudication ritual treats mutual peer-validation as a necessary condition before a flag becomes sustained; without the NU-layer agreement, a single critic failure would remain provisional.
